combustion_system.description: Lean-burn compression ignition with spark plug control

forced_induction.purpose: Enables compression ignition at all loads

vehicle_applications.note: Not available in North America as of 2024

engine_oil.spec: API SP, Mazda Original Oil 0W-20 GF-6A

notes.heritage: Skyactiv-X is Mazda's groundbreaking compression-ignition gasoline engine - the first of its kind in production.
notes.reputation: Revolutionary technology that bridges gasoline and diesel efficiency. Complex but impressive engineering achievement.
notes.design_philosophy: SPCCI (Spark Controlled Compression Ignition) enables lean-burn compression ignition for diesel-like efficiency with gasoline fuel.

how_spcci_works.step_1: Ultra-lean air/fuel mixture compressed to near-ignition point
how_spcci_works.step_2: Spark plug creates small ignition kernel
how_spcci_works.step_3: Expanding flame ball compresses remaining mixture
how_spcci_works.result: Higher thermal efficiency than conventional spark ignition

common_issues: Requires premium fuel in most markets
Cold-start behavior differs from conventional engines

market_availability.reason: Emissions certification complexity and market focus

notes.tuning_notes: Not recommended. SPCCI system is extremely sensitive to modifications. No aftermarket support.
